description: How much the invoice will be if the account reduces its ADDITIONAL storage — to a new total (target_total_gb) or by removing an amount (remove_gb), in GB (1 TB = 1024 GB). Without an amount, returns the current storage, what is in use and the smallest possible total. Refuses totals below what is already in use or below what the plan includes (plan storage only changes by changing plans). It never applies the change (that is done in the dashboard). dry_run=true (default) checks the new total against the plan and usage without calling billing; dry_run=false also gets the price from billing (same calculation as the dashboard cart: next invoice, next cycles, savings). Side effect of dry_run=false, same as opening the preview in the dashboard: if the account has a subscription but no default payment method, Panda's billing sets its first saved card as the default payment method.

dry_run.description: true = check the new total only; false = also get the price from billing

remove_gb.description: How much to remove from the current total, in GB. Use this OR target_total_gb.

target_total_gb.description: Desired new TOTAL storage, in GB (1 TB = 1024 GB). Use this OR remove_gb.

name: panda_action_preview_storage_reduction
title: Preview Storage Reduction
